markers.label: page too wide
markers.title: Page wider than the window
markers.body: At 1,440 px the rebuild’s page is 1,500 px wide. Its cards are 350 px wide, not 331 px, so the fourth column runs off the right edge.

markers.label: arrow off screen
markers.title: Next arrow off screen
markers.body: The banner stretches with the wider page. That enlarges its art and puts the next arrow at 1,439 px, past the edge of the window. In the reference it starts at 1,363 px.

markers.label: different arrows
markers.title: Different arrow characters
markers.body: The carousel arrows are ‹ › in the reference and ❮ ❯ in the rebuild. The test compares a hash of the page text, so the text check fails and no similarity is recorded.

markers.label: filter wraps
markers.title: Filter label wraps
markers.body: “Beauty & Personal Care” breaks onto two lines in the rebuild, so the rest of the sidebar sits 17 px lower. Products, prices and photos match. The text checks pass and similarity is 0.9413, so the test passes.

markers.label: desktop layout
markers.title: No phone layout
markers.body: At 390 px the reference switches to a phone layout. The rebuild keeps its desktop layout on a page 1,010 px wide, so most of it is off screen. Similarity is 0.0397.

markers.label: not compared
markers.title: Header differs, but isn’t compared
markers.body: The search button sits 4 px further left and the category menu shows “Book”, not “Boo”. This test’s screenshot region starts at y = 64, below the header. Everything inside it matches: similarity 0.9999.

markers.label: no sign-in
markers.title: Adds to the cart without sign-in
markers.body: Selecting + on a deal while signed out opens sign-in in the reference. The rebuild adds the item and opens the cart. Its form posts to /gp/cart/add, so the test can’t find the /gp/cart/add.html form it clicks.
